newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus says results will not disappoint.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus says results will not disappoint.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd, Australia's second largest telecommunications group, said on Monday that its annual results to be released on Wednesday would be within market expectations.
"I think the financial community will not be disappointed." chief operating officer Phil Jacobs told reporters.
"I think they will be seen to be positive," he said.
Jacobs said Optus was on track to proceed with its stock market float later this year. Asked when the company would release a prospectus, Jacobs replied: "Very soon."
Optus is expected to report a net profit of A$55 million to A$65 million for the year to June 30.
Optus shareholders include Mayne Nickless Ltd, BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc, which each hold about one quarter of the company.
Mayne Nickless says it plans to sell its stake.
